reviewer: Agent visual review of co-registered 2024 LiDAR height and 2026-04-10 RGB/CIR, with existing individual locations shown
positionPolicy: Use the source-height-weighted LiDAR crown centre. Do not snap to image centres or invent stem locations. Horizontal uncertainty 2 m is a judgement, not measured accuracy.

hold.4: Low sparse vegetation: tree versus shrub identity and base are ambiguous.
hold.5: Fragmented low canopy: crown and stem cannot be distinguished reliably.

hold.2: Segmentation divides connected canopy around an existing individual; correspondence and split remain ambiguous.
hold.4: Same connected group as candidate 2 and an existing individual; do not add a potentially duplicate tree.

hold.1: Crown crosses the source-review boundary; complete outline was not reviewed.
hold.5: Small attached segment may belong to the broad neighbouring crown 4.
hold.19: Connected crown group contains an existing tree; uncertain correspondence.

limits: Purposive review, not a completeness annotation. Fresh evaluation scenes remain unedited. Retained existing trees receive no inferred position update. No infrared-only removal or species inference.
